issues.description: The template's example Main.java uses farm.feed() in the commented sample code, while the problem statement and the solution expect the method to be named feedAllAnimals(). This identifier mismatch for the same conceptual operation can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example code in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (template) to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), so it aligns with the method name specified in the problem statement and used in the solution. Alternatively, if feed() was intended, update the problem statement and solution to use feed() consistently.
